query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS gcms_chromatograms (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  landrace_id INT,
  landrace_name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  analysis_date DATE,
  instrument VARCHAR(255) DEFAULT 'Agilent 7890B GC / 5977B MSD',
  column_type VARCHAR(255) DEFAULT 'HP-5MS (30m x 0.25mm x 0.25μm)',
  carrier_gas VARCHAR(50) DEFAULT 'Hélium',
  flow_rate DECIMAL(5,2) DEFAULT 1.0,
  injection_volume DECIMAL(5,2) DEFAULT 1.0,
  split_ratio VARCHAR(50) DEFAULT '50:1',
  oven_program TEXT,
  total_peaks INT,
  identified_peaks INT,
  notes TEXT,
  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);
